title: Engagement ring edit and editorial guide for Canadian search interest
body:
H.E.R. — HER ETERNAL REIGN

No queen stands alone.

Around the finger, a continuous procession of crowned female figures moves without beginning or end. Each wears her own crown. Each carries her own gemstone identity. None is repeated, and none is diminished by the company she keeps.

This is a sculptural PHILEON ring about sovereignty as something shared, a line of women who hold their authority in full view and in step with one another.

Cast in 10K, 14K or 18K yellow gold, set with genuine or lab-grown stones, and made to order.

H.E.R. is not worn to follow convention. It is worn to declare identity.

PHILEON. Identity Beyond Convention.
